column1: # Client and world-profile settings. Pipe-separated; run python catalog/build_catalog.py after editing.
# editor: toggle | number | slider | choice | text | secret

world-profile|world-profile.json||name|world.rules|World name|The name of your saved world. The launcher derives the world's database from this name, so it can only be changed in the launcher.|text|string||||||0|Renaming the world would point it at a different, empty database. Rename it in the launcher instead.|0

world-profile|world-profile.json||simsPercent|world.population|World sims|How many simulated players fill your world, compared with the full shipped world. 100% is the world as intended; lower it if your computer struggles.|slider|int||%|25|100|100|0||0

world-profile|world-profile.json||shopsPercent|world.population|Offline shops|How many sim-run offline shops appear in towns. Above 100% needs "Allow more shops than shipped".|slider|int||%|0|200|100|0||0
world-profile|world-profile.json||shopsOverArmed|world.population|Allow more shops than shipped|Lets the offline shops setting go up to 200%. More shops use more memory.|toggle|bool|||||false|0||0

world-profile|world-profile.json||freeClassChange|world.rules|Free class change|On: class changes at level 20, 40 and 76 are free from the Class Masters. Off: the retail class-change quests are required. The launcher writes the matching ClassMaster.xml when the world starts.|toggle|bool|||||true|0||0
client-option|Option.ini|Video|GamePlayViewportX|clientgfx.display|Resolution width|Width of the game in pixels.|number|int||px|640|7680|1024|0||0
client-option|Option.ini|Video|GamePlayViewportY|clientgfx.display|Resolution height|Height of the game in pixels.|number|int||px|480|4320|768|0||0

client-option|Option.ini|Video|TextureDetail|clientgfx.detail|Texture detail|Same as the in-game Texture Detail option. If unsure which number is which, change it in game and compare.|choice|int|0=0;1=1;2=2||||0|0||0
client-option|Option.ini|Video|ModelDetail|clientgfx.detail|Character model detail|Same as the in-game Model Detail option.|choice|int|0=0;1=1;2=2||||0|0||0
client-option|Option.ini|Video|IsKeepMinFrameRate|clientgfx.detail|Lower detail to keep the frame rate up||toggle|bool|||||True|0||0

client-option|Option.ini|Video|RenderActorLimited|clientgfx.distance|Limit how many characters are drawn|Same as the in-game character limit option. Higher numbers draw more characters; useful in crowded towns full of sims.|number|int|||0|10|6|0||0
client-option|Option.ini|Game|EnterChatting|clientgame.chat|Press Enter to start typing in chat||toggle|bool|||||True|0||0
client-option|Option.ini|Game|ShowZoneTitle|clientgame.interface|Show zone names when entering an area||toggle|bool|||||True|0||0
client-option|Option.ini|Game|PartyLooting|clientgame.interface|Default party loot rule||choice|int|0=Finders keepers;1=Random;2=Random including spoil;3=By turn;4=By turn including spoil||||0|0||0

client-l2ini|l2.ini|URL|ServerAddr|clientconn.server|Server address|The login server the client connects to. 127.0.0.1 is your own world.|text|string||||||0|Written by the L2Everdream launcher every time you press Play (your world, the official world, or a friend's IP).|0
client-l2ini|l2.ini|AutoLogOn|IsL2AutoLogOn|clientconn.autologin|Log in automatically|Skip the login screen using the account below. Stored in plain text inside l2.ini.|toggle|bool|||||False|0||0
client-l2ini|l2.ini|AutoLogOn|L2Passwd|clientconn.autologin|Account password|Hidden here, but stored in plain text inside l2.ini.|secret|string||||||0||1
